modmenu.summaryTranslation.chunkstorageo: Suffereth Chunk Storage Optimizer worlds to keep their .cso format with C2ME installed.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.chunkstor: C2ME's chunk IO rewrite would read the .mca files right past Chunk Storage Optimizer, and a converted world should have its terrain silently born anew. This compat joineth the two, world by world: worlds the storage mod serveth keep the vanilla IO worker, worlds upon plain Anvil keep C2ME's rewrite. It doth nothing without C2ME.
